values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day campsite reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. The registered camper (18+) must be on site for the first 24 hours. Cabins need 7 or 14 nights in peak season (late June-late August).

summary: Confirmed 2027 season May 7-Oct 10, flagship, reservable on ReserveAmerica (booking was only inherited; now verified). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 50 A max (31 of 95 listed sites electric), 100 sites to 50 ft (back-in; 20 tent-only), showers, dump, water fill.
